value_text: Contract auto-renews unless written notice is delivered before the notice deadline.
Renewal or non-renewal notice must be delivered 90 days before term end.
Benchmarking rights are present for role mix, service tower rates, and SLA structure once per contract year.
Termination for convenience allowed with 120 day transition assistance; fees capped at two months of run fees.
Monthly service credit equals 2 percent of the monthly base fee for each breached service tower, capped at 8 percent per month.
Change order requires written scope classification, original SOW cross reference, buyer approval, and recurring-vs-one-time flag.
Supplier must maintain approved resource mix and disclose role location, skill family, named lead coverage, and vacancy aging monthly.
Supplier must maintain current runbooks, report catalog, lineage map, and transition backlog for buyer access.
